queue: Per-die power-of-two dirty capacity >= boundary slots; 8-entry output ring; global per-owner update cursor; per-actor/per-die explicit command cursor
delivery: Drain output credits, sort by worker/node, rewrite only lane-local transport serial, deliver via unchanged receiver kernel
termination: A pump producing fewer than eight updates has exhausted the filtered pass under the checked visit budget; a full batch is followed by another pump
concurrency: Per-die mutex serializes CUs. Queries on immutable joined-phase snapshots OR disjoint lane subscription bits; canonical actor-order capture is a valid linearization

metrics: Refresh publication_scans is zero; all empty pump calls, visits, output records, cold queries, rejected validations and replay work remain counted
